formal_statement:
theorem OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.selectedMinor_clearing_bound {m K : ℕ} {w0 v0 θ F H : ℝ}
    (p : Fin m → ℤ) (q : Fin m → ℕ) (hq : ∀ i, 2 ≤ q i) (hw0 : 0 < w0)
    (selection : InterpolationMatrix.Row K v0 θ (logWeights q) H →
      InterpolationMatrix.Column w0 (logWeights q) H)
    (hdet : (selectedMinor K w0 v0 θ F H p q selection).det ≠ 0) :
    -(Fintype.card (InterpolationMatrix.Row K v0 θ (logWeights q) H) : ℝ) *
      Real.log (denominator q (truncationOrders q F v0) H) -
      columnCost q selection + rowCost K v0 θ q H ≤
      Real.log ‖(selectedMinor K w0 v0 θ F H p q selection).det‖ := by
  sorry

metadata.title: A denominator-clearing lower bound for a selected interpolation minor
metadata.statement: For the original truncated-logarithm interpolation matrix, choose a square minor with nonzero determinant. Under the stated positive integer denominator and weight assumptions, its logarithmic determinant is bounded below by the negative row-count times the logarithm of the common denominator, minus the selected column cost, plus the row cost. The definitions and indices are exactly those of the source theorem.
metadata.explanation: Clear denominators entrywise into Gaussian integers, then apply the source determinant norm bound and expand the logarithms of row and column scales.
